document.title: Remove the public index CLI command
document.summary: The public `index` command is gone. `review` still writes the covering skeleton. Docs and the next skill point at `review`.
document.why: [The session](source:s1) asks to drop leftover public `comprehende index` after `review` became the skill path.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 21
sources.gist: Remove leftover public index CLI. Keep hunk indexing as an internal library used by review. Leave the published skill until a release.

sources.label: PR #98
sources.title: Remove the public index CLI command
sources.gist: Drop index from the public CLI. Keep cmdIndex as an internal library. Leave skills/comprehende unchanged.

lookFor: [The session](source:s1) asks to leave `skills/comprehende/` until a release. No hunk touches that tree.
[The session](source:s1) prefers no `package.json` bump. No hunk edits that file.

groups.title: Drop the public command
groups.why: [The session](source:s1) asks to remove leftover public `index` from the CLI.
groups.summary: `CommandName` and `--help` drop `index`. `main` no longer prints that hunk list.
lookFor: `comprehende index` is unknown. `cmdReview` still calls `cmdIndex` in `commands.ts`.

groups.title: Reject index in parse and help
groups.why: The CLI contract needs a test that `index` is gone from parse and `--help`.
groups.summary: `parseArgv` and `run` treat `index` as an unknown command.

groups.title: Packed bin uses the skeleton
groups.why: The tarball path must prove `review` covers hunks without a public `index` bin.
groups.summary: The packed bin rejects `index` and validates the `review` skeleton.
lookFor: Packed `review` writes group id `ungrouped`. Export markdown follows that id, not `all`.

groups.summary: README, AGENTS.md, and the next-skill example send agents to `review`.

commits.subject: Fix pack-smoke export asserts for the review skeleton.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The covering document used group id all. review writes ungrouped, so
export markdown paths follow that id.

commits.subject: Remove the public index CLI command.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Hunk indexing stays an internal library used by review. Agents copy refs
from the covering skeleton. Skills-next and docs tell them to re-run
review when refs go stale. The published skill is unchanged.
